Class ChaosScenarioLifecycleEvent

java.lang.Object
jdk.jfr.Event
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.bootstrap.jfr.ChaosScenarioLifecycleEvent
@Internal public final class ChaosScenarioLifecycleEvent extends Event
JFR event emitted on every chaos scenario state transition: REGISTERED, STARTED, STOPPED, INACTIVE, RELEASED.

Enabled by default — lifecycle transitions are infrequent (one per test phase boundary) so the overhead is negligible. Correlate with ChaosEffectAppliedEvent via scenarioId to reconstruct the full chaos timeline in a JFR recording.
